checkpoints.description: [1/2] Make lookup errors context-aware and machine-readable under --json

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed show/delete lookup failures print replay-specific guidance and emit human text under --json, breaking agent parsing.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each command explains its own failure, and agents get a parseable JSON error object.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: JSON error shape is new, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Parameterise the shared lookup helper with context and json_mode, reuse it in delete, and add failing-first tests for show/delete wording and JSON parsing.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Emit machine-readable success objects for clear, import and replay under --json

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed clear and import still print human text with --json, so agents cannot parse mutating-command results.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every command result is parseable in JSON mode, matching the existing delete and error behaviour.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new JSON success shapes, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Print structured objects only when args.json is true, keep human text unchanged, and add failing-first parse tests.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Emit structured replay failures in --json mode

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed replay failures still print prose under --json, unlike every other command result after ADR-020.
impact_assessment.benefits: Agent consumers can parse both successful and failed replays uniformly.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new JSON error object, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Branch only the error print on json_mode, keep the same return code and human text, and add failing-first tests for bad URL and unreachable target.

checkpoints.head: 65c959fbc2a5cd0531ea0a89c26af32655db9f80

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Capture non-GET requests sent to read-only control paths

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed POST /__inbox and PUT /__health get a control response and are never captured, breaking the any-method capture contract.
impact_assessment.benefits: No webhook is silently discarded because of its path; only GET/HEAD keep the control responses.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: non-GET requests to those paths change from control response to capture, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Gate the two read-only handlers on method in _route, add raw-socket failing-first tests, and keep GET/HEAD behaviour unchanged.
